comments.value: I suggested this a long time ago, as well as translation of the ToS. At certain time, VRChat is filled with Russians and Japanese, and I definitely met users who don't understand English, but they accepted the rules anyway. Instead, VRC should let the users choose preferred language, provide them with the ToS along with a short list of rules ("TL;DR"), so only then they could start using the app. I heard a lot of feedback from people who didn't even know why they got banned just because they didn't speak English in the first place.
I dont have problems with the UI and would leave it english, but I would certainly like to help translating it to german or spanish.

I for yours. I think there are so many people can do it as volunteer. I'm translating a Discord bot into Japanese with crowdin( https://crowdin.com/ ). That's so easy to find translators and translate into many languages.

comments.mergedPostDetails: It would be an good idea to have different languages in the client UI, either by hiring translators of recieving help from the community with an wide language range. SInce there are some worlds that are on specific languages maybe the client having different languages could help those that aren't really good at english but enjoy the game.

So apparently. VRChat's popularity is somehow blowing up in Asia, (Mostly Japan and Korea) which the game managed to get an appearance on a Japanese news program.

I think we can clearly understand that not all of the VRChat players are native English speakers. So I was wondering if we are able to get translations for the game in the future at some point? That would really help non-English VRChat players navigate through the UI better if it's translated to their own language.

details:
We've got quite a big community of Chinese, Japanese and Korean on VRChat. But, the UI still doesn't have any translations for these languages which work completely differently than english. Not to speak of Russian, Spanish and Italian communities either.

We could crowdsource the translation through the community or we might find a different method depending on what the developers say or maybe you've got thoughts about it?

In any way, it'd be nice to see something like this happening considering how many foreigners who have english as their second language or have difficulty understanding it at all on VRChat and it's always nice to make it easier for them to understand the options menu and the UI itself!

Hopefully someone else agrees with me.
title: UI Translation for different languages
